full_text_tesim: Common codicological and palaeographical features suggest that the three Hippocratic UTOs and the two other medical UTOs in this codex ("Antyllus?, Recipes for different diseases" and "Treatise on medical terms") belonged to the same original manuscript. The following folios could also possibly belong to "Hippocrates' Letters": 8r (middle piece), 8v (middle piece), 9r (middle piece), 9v (middle piece) (Rossetto)
Original recto: 8r top+58r (col. a), 9v top+61v (col. a), 58r (col. b), 61v (col. b); original verso: 58v (col. a), 61r (col. a), 58v (col. b)+8v top, 61r (col. b )+9r top (Rossetto)
Round biblical majuscule. Copied by the same hand as the UTO “Hippocrates, Epidemics” (Rossetto)
To the same original manuscript belong also folios from Sinai Arabic NF M 27 (Rossetto)
UTO Sinai Arabic NF M 8, SPP No. 143
